name: ShopPilot Holiday Shopping Assistant
description: Automated holiday shopping assistant built with Google ADK. Discovers verified multi-retailer deals, detects inflated fake holiday discounts using 90-day price history, stacks coupons and cashback rewards, and manages holiday gift budgets & watchlists.

skills.name: Holiday Deal Discovery & Price Comparison
skills.description: Searches across major retailers, computes total landed costs, and ranks offers by authenticity-adjusted deal score.
examples: Find the best holiday deals on noise-canceling headphones under $300.
Compare prices for the LG 65-inch C4 OLED TV across Costco, Best Buy, and Amazon.

skills.name: Fake Deal Detection & Buy-Timing Advisor
skills.description: Audits 90-day price history and past Black Friday lows to detect artificially inflated MSRP sales and issue BUY_NOW, WAIT, SET_ALERT, or AVOID_FAKE_DEAL verdicts.
examples: Is the UltraChef Smart Air Fryer Pro a real holiday deal or a fake markup?
Should I buy the Sony WH-1000XM5 now or wait for Black Friday?

skills.name: Coupon & Cashback Stacking Calculator
skills.description: Finds active holiday promo codes, cashback portals, and credit card multipliers to calculate effective net price.
examples: What coupons and cashback can I stack on a $280 Best Buy order?

skills.name: Gift Budget, Watchlist & Multi-Gift Bundle Optimizer
skills.description: Persists user memberships, holiday budgets, per-recipient allocations, watchlists, price-drop alerts, and optimizes multi-recipient gift bundles under a strict budget.
examples: Set my holiday budget to $600 and add Sony WH-1000XM5 for my sister with a $280 target.
Plan a holiday gift bundle for Mom, Dad, and my nephew under $300 total.
